archer.name: Archer
lines: Keep your voice down. The woods are listening tonight.
I saw movement near the old path before sunset.
If you keep going, stay close and trust what you hear.

guardian.name: Guardian
lines: If you are heading deeper inside, stay ready and do not travel alone.
The road ahead looks calm, but it never stays that way for long.
Come back if you need cover. I will keep watch here.

villager.name: Villager
lines: Good evening. Strange things have been happening near the village.
People say the forest grows louder after dark.
If you learn anything, please come tell us.
